hooks.command: echo "\" | Out-Null <# " >/dev/null; if command -v worklog >/dev/null 2>&1; then worklog session-start; fi; exit $? #> ; if (Get-Command worklog -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { worklog session-start; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0

echo "\" | Out-Null <# " >/dev/null; if command -v worklog >/dev/null 2>&1; then worklog update --auto; fi; exit $? #> ; if (Get-Command worklog -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { worklog update --auto; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0

echo "\" | Out-Null <# " >/dev/null; if command -v worklog >/dev/null 2>&1; then worklog session-end; fi; exit $? #> ; if (Get-Command worklog -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { worklog session-end; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0
